verdict.rationale: Runloop is infrastructure for building/running AI agents and sandboxes (Devboxes, Axons, Agents API, benchmarks) — it is a platform for developers to deploy their own agents, not a product with a built-in assistant that end-users delegate tasks to. This is a category mismatch: the story applies to end-user products with an embedded assistant, not to a sandbox/agent-hosting infrastructure platform.
